title: AgriSentinel RunState
description: The single event-sourced object every agent reads and writes. FROZEN after Phase 0 — changing it breaks both devs at once. Agents never call each other directly; they only mutate this.

crop.description: Crop under inspection. Prototype scope: tomato, potato, corn.

status.description: Lifecycle of the run. 'complete' = pipeline finished and shipped advice. 'blocked' = pipeline finished but the Verifier withheld the treatment plan; diagnosis and severity are still valid and must still be shown. 'error' = the pipeline itself failed. A blocked run is not an error.

image_url.description: Path the frontend can GET to render the field image under the heatmap. Backend-served; demo-mode replay relies on this because it has no uploaded File object.

started_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC. Drives the elapsed-run timer in the UI so it survives an SSE reconnect.

finished_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC. Null while the run is in flight.

tiles.description: One entry per grid cell, including skipped ones. Grid dimensions are derived by the UI from max x and max y — there is no separate rows/cols field.

id.description: t_<xx>_<yy>, zero-padded, matching this tile's x and y.

y.description: Row index, 0-based, increasing SOUTH (image convention: y=0 is the top/north edge). Compass bearings must account for this.

label.description: 'healthy', a disease class name, or a 'skipped_*' value when the Scout's green-mask filter rejected the tile as soil/sky. The UI colours any label starting with 'skipped' as inactive grey.

confidence.description: Softmax confidence for the label. Null for skipped tiles — they were never scored.

escalated.description: True if this tile fell below the confidence gate and was re-scored by the Second-Opinion agent. The confidence shown is the post-TTA value.

spread.description: Populated by the Spread Analyst. Null until it runs.

pct_affected.description: Infected tiles as a percentage of SCORED tiles (skipped tiles are excluded from the denominator).

clusters.description: Distinct infection clusters found by DBSCAN over infected tile coordinates.

direction.description: Compass bearing from the field centroid to the infection-weighted centroid. Null when there is nothing infected to point at.

est_yield_loss_pct.description: pct_affected multiplied by a per-disease severity weight. A rough published-range estimate, NOT a clinical figure — the weights table carries that caveat.

cluster_centroids.description: Optional. Centroid of each cluster in tile coordinates, for future overlay work.

plan_draft.description: Markdown treatment plan from the Agronomist. Every sentence ends with a source marker like [doc_12#p3] whose id MUST exist in verification.sources. Null before the Agronomist runs, and on a BLOCK outcome.
examples:
## Immediate action
Apply a protectant fungicide within 48 hours. [doc_12#p3]

verification.description: The Verifier's ruling. It has veto power — the orchestrator obeys this, not the Agronomist.

status.description: PASS: every claim grounded. REWRITE: sent back to the Agronomist (max 2 retries, then the offending sentences are stripped and it PASSes with unsupported_claims still populated). BLOCK: an allowlist or dosage violation — no treatment advice ships at all.

unsupported_claims.description: Sentences that could not be traced to a retrieved chunk. Non-empty alongside a PASS means the plan was revised — the UI shows a 'plan revised for accuracy' note.

sources.description: Retrieved chunks backing the plan. Objects, not bare ids, because the UI renders a source drawer with the actual text. Supersedes the bare-string sketch in the architecture doc.

id.description: The marker used inline in plan_draft.

doc.description: Human-readable document title for the drawer header.

text.description: The retrieved chunk verbatim. This is what makes the grounding checkable on screen.

block_reason.description: Present only when status is BLOCK. Plain language, shown on the refusal card.

schedule.description: Action Planner output, ordered by day_offset. Null or empty on a BLOCK.

day_offset.description: Days from the scan date. 0 is today — the UI puts its 'today' marker here.

action.description: Short imperative label for the timeline node.

note.description: Detail revealed when the node is expanded.

kind.description: Optional. Lets the UI style the re-scan node distinctly.

cost_estimate.description: Rough treatment cost from a small lookup table. A band, deliberately not a single number.

note.description: Basis of the estimate, e.g. per-acre assumption.

rescan_date.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) for the follow-up scan. Highlighted on the timeline.

report.description: Farmer-facing brief. Max ~6 short sentences per language, plain words, no jargon.

events.description: Append-only agent event log, oldest first. Rendered live in the UI — this is what makes the orchestration visible. Dotted namespace: <agent>.<event>[.<detail>]. Known prefixes: run.start, scout.done, diagnose.tile.<tile_id>, diagnose.done, orchestrator.escalate.<n>_tiles, second_opinion.done, spread.done, agronomist.done, verify.pass, verify.rewrite, verify.block, planner.done, reporter.done, run.complete, run.error. The UI falls back to a neutral style for anything unrecognised, so new events are safe to add.
